svg.title: The same stage boundary at different depths
svg.text: One boundary, one age, up to five depths
The beginning of each stage as Railsback et al. (2015) date it; the depth is geolod:atDepth_m of the node a geolod:MISAttributeAssignment points to, one per timescale.
A dot in the place of a depth: the record does not reach that stage on that scale. Spread = deepest minus shallowest depth of the same boundary.
The five scales date different records (gas or ice phase of the same core), so the depths differ although the age is the same.
